limitations: Website claims and displayed reviews are publisher-supplied and were not independently verified.
No social-ad engagement, impressions, spend or conversions were collected; no best-performing format can be established.
Creator profiles are linked from the brand website, not independently verified audience or performance matches.
Model interpretations describe supplied website text; they are not measured audience facts.
Previously curated external source entries were not re-fetched during this website refresh; their original observation timestamps were retained.
Competitor candidates were selected from source-backed category overlap for this test, not automatically discovered or performance-validated.
The initial visual model can confuse gift-set packaging with cosmetics; this unvalidated interpretation is a classification gap, not a verified product/ad-format label.
Instagram profile counters do not identify which ad formats earn engagement or conversions.
A bounded public Meta ad-library sample was collected separately from website research. It contains creative/delivery evidence without engagement counts or a usable rate denominator.
Website and ad-library captures have independent observation dates; this saved case is not a continuous monitoring feed.

proposedTests.hypothesis: Test an everyday-use creator demonstration grounded in the brand’s stated creator direction. This is a creative hypothesis, not an observed performance winner.
Test a permission-cleared customer-review execution using a specific product experience. Website reviews establish message material, not conversion effectiveness.
Test a clear product-bundle or value proposition using only verified current offer terms. Website offer presence does not establish that this format performs best.
